story.text: A very special island is inhabited only by altruists and egoists. Altruists always tell the truth, and egoists always lie. You meet 2 inhabitants: William, and Oliver. In a statement by William: "Oliver is an egoist". "if Oliver is an altruist then William is an egoist," Oliver declared. So who is an altruist and who is an egoist? (Format your answer like: "William is a altruist/egoist, and Oliver is a altruist/egoist")

options: William is an egoist, Oliver is an egoist
William is an altruist, Oliver is an altruist
William is an egoist, Oliver is an altruist
William is an altruist, Oliver is an egoist

William 说：“不是（Oliver是an altruist）”
Oliver 说：“如果（Oliver是an altruist）那么（William是an egoist）”

William 是利他者，Oliver 是利他者
William 是利己者，Oliver 是利他者
